result.document_summary: A page of San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 4 (Health and Sanitation) text covering sewage disposal system regulation and bathhouse permitting, retrieved from a code-publisher URL that nominally concerns algorithmic rent price fixing but whose content in this part does not.
result.notes: No rules in scope. This part contains only San Diego Municipal Code sections 42.0301-42.0304 (sewage disposal systems) and 42.0401-42.0414 (bathhouse permits, facilities, and operating requirements). Nothing addresses rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, application screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting. The source URL references an algorithmic rent price-fixing division (§ 98.1103), but that text is not present in this part of the document.
